choices.A: Drawing 2 balls simultaneously from a bag.
choices.B: Drawing 1 ball, recording its color, replacing it, and then drawing another.
choices.C: Returning the ball to the bag and mixing thoroughly after every draw.
choices.D: Drawing balls twice in succession, with the same number of balls in the bag before each draw.

question: Which of the following situations involves drawing balls without replacement?
solution: Drawing 2 balls simultaneously is equivalent to drawing the first ball without replacing it before drawing the second. B, C, and D all involve replacement.
